title: Rolen Ofandrus
dek: Rolen makes protection practical: equipment prepared by hand, newcomers taught patiently and a range made useful to the town.

facts.Early role: Range owner · bow and arrow maker

body:
Rolen is already part of Pristinia’s recovered militia and expedition history. The range scenes show the quieter work behind that public role.

Rolen makes the range usable

In March 2024, Rolen remodels and cleans the range while preparing bows, crossbows and arrows for business. He identifies himself to Pilanas Cristias as its owner and describes training and practice as its purpose. His work makes a place where equipment, instruction and a welcoming first conversation meet.

Scene evidence: 1, 2, 3, 4.

Pilanas learns the craft

Pilanas asks to learn woodworking. Rolen warns that shaping good arrow shafts takes years of practice, then offers a useful starting task: attaching heads to shafts he has prepared. When she hears condescension in his explanation, he clarifies that he meant the task is easier, not that she is incapable. He demonstrates the glue and fitting process, leaving further instruction open. Craft is passed through patient work rather than a promise of instant mastery.

Scene evidence: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

Learning to protect oneself

Claire Hearthford brings Kathie to learn self-defense. Rolen presents a carved training bow, adjusts the trainees’ technique and encourages them after misses. Claire tells Kathie to attend to posture, aim and breathing instead of the target alone. Jako’s account explicitly credits Rolen’s encouragement with easing frustration and improving a shot. The range serves families and newcomers as well as experienced adventurers.

Scene evidence: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

His later status is not established by this early range history. Read the town’s wider militia record.

profile.personality: Rolen is an organizer before he is a symbol. He approaches danger through training, patrols, chains of command, and the belief that ordinary volunteers deserve preparation rather than heroic rhetoric. At the range, patient encouragement and correction accompany his exacting craft standards.
profile.achievements: He helps reopen Eovar’s road, leads militia planning, recovers bodies and missing companions from the mine, drills Pristinia’s volunteers, investigates the fog road, and responds to Eovar’s warning. His earliest deeds make him central to the settlement’s transformation from vulnerable camp into a place capable of defending itself. Remodeled the Archery Range, prepared ranged equipment, taught Pilanas to fit arrowheads and supported family training.
profile.relationships: Cobble and Vigr Frami are his closest recurring partners in early defense work, while Claire, Quake, Elenia, Adelia, Alyhotep, and Loistava move through the teams he helps coordinate. His relationships are expressed through entrusted roles: who scouts, who trains, who carries the dead, and who is prepared to take over when he is absent.
